## Background

I am Amir Masoud Nourollah (Masoud), a PhD student in the Department of Computer Science at [Cardiff University](https://www.cardiff.ac.uk/), where I am part of the [Cardiff NLP](https://cardiffnlp.github.io/) and [Knowledge Representation and Reasoning](https://krr-cu.github.io) groups. I started my PhD in 2024.

My academic background spans chemistry and computer science. I studied Chemistry (2016–2020) before moving into Computer Science, completing a Master's degree focused on artificial intelligence and robotics (2020–2023). Since my undergraduate studies I have also worked in industry as a software engineer and machine learning researcher, across computer vision, speech processing and natural language processing.

I have explored programming languages and the GNU/Linux ecosystem for nearly two decades, and that interest in systems predates my formal studies. Alongside research, I care about engineering practice, infrastructure and open-source software.

## Research Interests

- Scientific machine learning (SciML) for chemistry and molecular systems
- Generalisation and distribution shift in machine learning
- Interpretability and explainability of ML models
- Geometric deep learning and graph neural networks
- Multimodal machine learning
- Neural rendering & simulation

## Research Groups

At Cardiff I am a member of the [Cardiff NLP](https://cardiffnlp.github.io/) group, which works on representation learning, reasoning and language understanding, and the [Knowledge Representation and Reasoning](https://krr-cu.github.io) group, which studies formal and neural approaches to knowledge representation and reasoning.

During my master's studies I was a member of the Image Processing and Data Mining group at Shahrood University of Technology, where my work centred on computer vision and applied machine learning.

## Beyond Research

Outside of research, I enjoy reading literature, philosophy and science, particularly classic works, as well as Persian poetry. I am learning French, with Spanish as a future goal. I have a background in martial arts, having trained in Muay Thai and Judo.
